title: Danger Alarm
blurb: The danger alarm — the blaring red-alert klaxon of meme edits, deployed when a situation escalates beyond normal parameters. Someone's typing a paragraph? Danger alarm. The teacher says 'pop quiz'? Danger alarm. It converts any moment into a submarine emergency, which is usually the correct dramatization. Dive, dive, dive.
origin: The red-alert klaxon of meme edit culture.
